title: Placement Training Test - Analytical Reasoning & Critical Thinking
description: A modern placement-style assessment focused on analytical thinking, decision making, workplace problem solving, and logical reasoning.

questions.question: A team has 5 members. Every member shakes hands with every other member exactly once. How many handshakes occur?
A website receives 1000 visitors. 60% leave immediately. Of the remaining visitors, 50% sign up. How many users sign up?
A warehouse manager finds that Package A is heavier than Package B, and Package B is heavier than Package C. Which statement must be true?
options: Package A is heavier than Package C
Package C is heavier than Package A
Package A and Package C weigh the same
Cannot be determined

questions.question: A manager notices that project delays happen whenever requirements change. Which action best addresses the root cause?
options: Work longer hours
Reduce team size
Improve the requirement management process
Increase meetings

questions.question: Find the odd one out.
options: Compiler
Interpreter
Debugger
Keyboard

questions.question: A company has three teams: A, B, and C. Team A has more members than B. Team B has more members than C. Which statement is definitely true?
options: Team A has more members than C
Team C has more members than A
Teams A and C have the same number of members
Cannot be determined

questions.question: A process takes 10 minutes manually and 4 minutes using automation. What percentage of time is saved?
A customer reports a bug affecting payments. What should be your first priority?
options: Design new features
Investigate and resolve the payment issue
Update the company logo
Delay the response until next week

questions.question: A delivery team completed 80% of its assigned orders by 4 PM. The remaining orders are expected to take another 2 hours. Which conclusion is most reasonable?
options: The team has completed all orders
The team may complete the remaining orders by around 6 PM
The team will definitely finish before 5 PM
The remaining orders have already been cancelled

questions.question: Your teammate submits incomplete work shortly before a deadline. What is the most professional response?
options: Blame the teammate publicly
Ignore the issue
Work together to complete the missing parts and understand the problem
Report the teammate immediately without discussion
